teaser.en: Its smooth trunk peels like old paint, revealing patches of copper and green beneath.
teaser.sw: Shina lake laini humenyuka kama rangi kuukuu, likifichua mabaka ya rangi ya shaba na kijani chini yake.
teaser.dg: Gopha ra kolore laini rinatuluka vipande-vipande dza rangi ya kare, na kuonyesa mabaka ga rangi ya shaba na ya chijani photsize.

summary.en: *Mpera* is the guava, a small fruit tree planted around homesteads that has also run wild in the coastal bush. Its fruit is eaten fresh or made into juice and jam.
summary.sw: *Mpera* ni mpera, mti mdogo wa matunda unaopandwa kuzunguka makazi ambao pia umejiotea porini pwani. Mapera huliwa yakiwa mabichi au hutengenezwa sharubati na jamu.
summary.dg: *Mpera* ni muhi mdide wa matunda unaophandwa kanda-kanda ya midzi, na piya ukaenea weruni pwani. Matundage nkuriwa dza garivyo au nkuhendwa madzi ga matunda na jamu.

about.en:
*Mpera* is a small tree with a smooth trunk whose thin bark flakes away in patches, leaving a mottled pattern. The leaves are opposite, oval and stiff, with clear raised veins, and give off a spicy smell when crushed.

The white flowers have a brush of many stamens. The round or pear-shaped fruit ripens yellow, with pale or pink flesh full of small hard seeds and a strong sweet scent.
about.sw:
*Mpera* ni mti mdogo wenye shina laini ambalo gome lake jembamba hubanduka kwa mabaka, likiacha mchoro wa madoadoa. Majani yake huota yakitazamana, yana umbo la yai na ni magumu, yakiwa na mishipa iliyoinuka inayoonekana wazi, na hutoa harufu ya kiungo yanapopondwa.

Maua meupe yana kishada cha stameni nyingi kama brashi. Tunda la mviringo au lenye umbo la peari huiva likawa la manjano, likiwa na nyama nyeupe au ya waridi iliyojaa mbegu ndogo ngumu, na lina harufu kali tamu.
about.dg:
*Mpera* ni muhi mdide wenye kolo laini, ambaro gophare dzembamba rinatuluka mabaka-mabaka, na kuricha alama za rangi tafwauti. Makodza ganamera ganalengana, ni ga duara-ndefu na magumu, gana mishipa yenye kuonekana sawa-sawa, na gachihopezwa ganalavya arufu dza ya viungo.

Maruwa mereru gana mafungu ga nyuzi nyinji. Tunda ra duara au renye umbo ra peya rinaivwa richikala ra rangi ya mandano, na nyamaze ni za rangi ngushu-ngushu au za rangi ya pinki, zenye tembe ndide ngumu nyinji na arufu nono ya mtswano.

where.en: Guava is grown around homesteads, and it has naturalised in the bush, where birds and people spread its seeds. Wild-growing guavas are a common sight along paths and old farms on the south coast.
where.sw: Mpera hupandwa kuzunguka makazi, na umejiotea porini, ambapo ndege na watu hueneza mbegu zake. Mipera inayojiotea yenyewe huonekana mara nyingi kando ya njia na kwenye mashamba ya zamani katika pwani ya kusini.
where.dg: Mpera unaphandwa kanda-kanda ya midzi, na ukaenea weruni, ambako nyuni na atu anatawanya tembeze. Mipera ya weruni ni kawaida kuiona kanda-kanda ya njira na kpwenye minda ya kare pwani ya kusini.

uses.en: The fruit is eaten fresh, pressed for juice and boiled into jam. The hard wood is used for tool handles, and the plant is used in medicine.
uses.sw: Matunda huliwa yakiwa mabichi, hukamuliwa sharubati na huchemshwa kutengeneza jamu. Mbao zake ngumu hutumika kutengenezea mipini ya zana, na mmea huu hutumika kama dawa.
uses.dg: Matunda ganariwa dza garivyo, nkuminywa kuhenda madzi ga matunda na nkutsemswa kuhenda jamu. Mbao ngumu nkuhumirwa kuhenda miphini ya vyombo, na mmea hinyu piya nkuhumirwa dza dawa.

names.en: The Digo name is *mpera*, the same as in Swahili, where the fruit is *pera*. In English it is guava.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *mpera*, sawa na la Kiswahili, ambapo tunda huitwa *pera*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *guava*.
names.dg: Dzinare kpwa Chidigo ni *mpera*, sawa na kpwa Chiswahili, ambamo tunda ni *pera*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *guava*.

reason.en: Same family, Myrtaceae; another homestead fruit
reason.sw: Wa familia moja, Myrtaceae; mti mwingine wa matunda wa nyumbani
reason.dg: Jamii mwenga, *Myrtaceae*; tunda ranjina ra midzini

reason.en: Wild relative in the myrtle family
reason.sw: Jamaa wa porini katika familia ya mihadasi (Myrtaceae)
reason.dg: Ndugu wa weruni wa jamii ya *myrtle*

reason.sw: Tunda lingine la kawaida la nyumbani
reason.dg: Tunda ranjina ra chila siku ra midzini
